rules.completion_vs_acceptance: run.completed means the worker stopped with an artifact. Only a human approval.decide(review, accept) produces task.accepted.
rules.cancellation: task.cancel on a running task records task.cancel_requested; the task becomes cancelled only when the worker acknowledges at its next tool boundary. In any non-running, non-terminal state it is cancelled immediately.
rules.retry: failed -> queued is a new run; no automatic retries in v0.1.
rules.timeout: A run that exceeds its turn or tool-call budget ends as failed with error 'budget_exhausted'.
rules.stale_version: Commands on an existing task must carry expected_version; a mismatch is rejected with 'stale_version' and nothing changes.
rules.duplicates: A repeated idempotency_key returns the first result with duplicate=true and has no further effect.
rules.replay: GET events?since=<cursor> returns events with cursor > since in order. Cursors are retained for the life of the store in v0.1; if since < oldest_cursor-1 the server answers 'cursor_expired' and the client must take a new snapshot.
rules.approval_binding: approval.decide carries the sha256 of the artifact that was reviewed; if the latest artifact differs the decision is rejected with 'approval_stale'.
rules.lesson_handoff: running -> queued happens only when a School lesson's interactive run ends (lesson.finish) and its review run is queued.
